headline: Fisherman's Row Erupts as Weathered Expanse Battle Rages On
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, Fisherman's Row has come back to the fore, with five ownership events in the last two hours and forty-six in the past day; Eidolo and Black Well bore the heaviest traffic. Weathered Expanse remains a roaring furnace, adding six fresh events in the latest two hours, with Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance all in action. Stonecradle, quiet in the last report, stirred again with five events in the final two hours, centering on World's End and The Cord, while Mooring County added three fresh events and nineteen for the day. Stlican Shelf cooled in the immediate two-hour window but still shows thirty-five day events, and LinnMercy has renewed movement at Lathair. Farranac Coast, busy earlier, has gone silent again. Daily casualties at the principal fronts remain severe. The war is in day 278; neither side has yet secured the thirty-four victory towns needed for decision.
